title: Professional Certificate in Human Resource Management And Organisational Strategy, Structure And Culture
description: This course offers an overview of the organisational culture theories and practices to enable the learner to appreciate the interplay of Human Resources and organisational culture.
longDescription: Organisational structure and culture. Culturally led theoretical models. Hofstede's Cultural Dimensions. Edgar Schein's Cultural Model. Charles Handy's Four Types Of Culture. Culture of an organisation. Interrelationships between human resource activities and culture. This course offers an overview of the organisational culture theories and practices to enable the learner to appreciate the interplay of Human Resources and organisational culture.
